title: Grateful Dead Live at Providence Civic Center on 1985-04-03
lineage: Master Cassettes (Set I Fugi FR type IV metal 90, Set II Maxell Metaxial 90) -> Tascam 112 -> RCA -> Edirol M-10dx 24bit 96kHz -> COAX -> M-audio Delta 1010lt -> Wave Lab 5.0 -> R8brainPro 16bit 44.1kHz  -> Traders Little Helper flac 8
source: Nakamichi CM 100's with CP-4 shotguns -> D-5

ai_review.summary: Bright, above‑average audience recording captures a tight, energetic Grateful Dead performance.
ai_review.review: The three reviewers agree the show is lively and well‑played, with a high‑energy vibe that keeps the crowd engaged. While it’s an audience (matrix) source with the usual hiss and crowd noise, the mix is relatively clear and bright for a crowd recording. Overall the performance shines despite the modest technical limitations.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently strong praise for the musical performance (70% weight) and generally favorable comments about the audience‑matrix recording quality (30% weight) lead to a solid four‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Typical audience hiss and crowd noise noted, but reviewers describe it as bright, clear enough, with good range and not overly noisy for a crowd recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set maintains high energy throughout, delivering a tight and enthusiastic performance that keeps the momentum flowing from start to finish.
